description: This PHP file defines the ClaimExpenseAPI class, which is a REST API controller handling CRUD operations (list, create, retrieve, update, delete) for Claim Expense entities within a Human Resource Management system (OrangeHRM). The class manages expenses associated with claim requests, including input validation, permission checks, and interaction with data access objects. It utilizes various traits and annotations for OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseAPI
classes.description: API controller class for handling CRUD operations related to claim expenses in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of claim expenses associated with a specific claim request, supporting sorting and filtering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new claim expense record based on input parameters.

methods.name: setClaimExpense
methods.description: Populates a ClaimExpense entity with request data, validating input and associating it with the parent claim request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes claim expense records for a specified claim request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'delete' endpoint.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single claim expense by its ID under a specific claim request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim expense record with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' endpoint.
